records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,

draft.subject: Thanks for the onboarding note, Theo
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thank you for the kind words about the onboarding flow — I passed them along, and your ticket is still open with Tariq, who is following up.

Since our kickoff, I wanted to check in on next steps. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so your first project is usually the natural starting point — and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help to get that first project set up together?

Best,
Priya
